about: Scenes the email name print has beyond the Logo studio's own lids. Each is a Content Library photo with its demo print removed and its front measured the way tools/signup/lid-geometry.js measures a lid. `source` is how the plate is made and measured (tools/email/build-extra-plates.js writes the plate to tools/email/name-print-plates/ and the measured quad and light back into `lid`); `lid` is what server/email/name-print.js reads, in the same shape as Logo studio's LIDS.

bag-white.product: Luksus gavepose med hank, XXL, hvid (32573401301): 450 x 350 x 150 mm, logo print on one side, at most 150 x 150 mm; bags take the logo module's own bag foils (BLACK GLOSSY - BAGS, RED MATT - BAGS, ...), not the boxes'

source.note: The bottom edge is the crease between the white front and the bag's bottom fold, so it is searched narrowly: a wide search locks onto the fold's outer edge against the black bag behind. Measured 2026-11-20: top 12/47 points (the handles hide the rest), right 48/48 rms 0.23 px, bottom 48/48 rms 0.78 px, left 47/47 rms 0.61 px; the perspective gives the front an aspect of 1.301 against 1.2857 from its 450 x 350 mm.

nyhavn.product: Copenhagen ECO smykkeæske til vedhæng / øreringe, blank rød plast (00500040402), 60 x 60 x 21 mm - here scaled up to a building on the quay in Nyhavn

source.generated: gpt-image-1.5 edit from the product packshot, 2026-11-20 (W50 Smykkeæske feature, "Din bedste reklameplads er et låg"); square crop 0,230,1024,1024 of the 1024x1536 render, resized to 1200
source.note: A generated scene, not a photo: there is no demo print to remove and the lid is domed, so the edge fit was not used. The quad is set by hand on the top face (left, back, right and front corners, text rising along the left-back edge as on Torino) and the light grid read with lid-geometry.js surface().
